feeds.title: Physician On FIRE Blog
feeds.description: Physician on FIRE is a personal finance website devoted to helping high-income professionals achieve financial independence and the option to retire early.

feeds.title: Financial Success MD Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Fawcett is a man on a mission to teach doctors how they can live healthy, happy, and debt-free lives-to regain control of their practice, their time, and their finances.

feeds.title: InvestingDoc
feeds.description: I am a physician in central Texas that specializes in Internal Medicine who started my own practice. This blog will be devoted to my journey to financial independence and covers posts about investing, personal finance, and retirement savings along the way. I hope you enjoy the blog.

feeds.title: The Frugal Physician Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Disha. I created this blog to help me reflect on our journey and to empower other physicians to get out of debt and take control of their finances.

feeds.title: Passive Income M.D
feeds.description: Physician, Passive Income Enthusiast, Blogger dedicated to helping others achieve financial freedom through multiple income streams.

feeds.title: Debt-Free Doctor » Personal Finance
feeds.description: Hi. My name is Dr. Jeff Anzalone and I'm a periodontist in Louisiana. My new purpose is to teach you everything I've learned along the way so you too can reach financial freedom much quicker than you'd ever thought possible.

feeds.title: The White Coat Investor
feeds.description: Blog posts that focuses on investing and issues facing doctors and other high net worth individuals. While that seems pretty niche, the topics The White Coat Investor covers really apply to most investors and anybody who invests and has student loan debt (another big area facing doctors).

feeds.title: Physician In Numbers » Finance
feeds.description: A female primary care physician opines on money, travel, fitness, and other topics.

feeds.title: The Loonie Doctor
feeds.description: A personal finance and investing site to inspire and empower Canadian physicians, and other high-income professionals, to be financial heroes, not hosers, eh.

feeds.title: Legal & Medical Investments Blog
feeds.description: Find out the latest news and our views on all things financial that affect doctors and dentists based in the UK. Get expert financial advice from independent financial advisers who know your profession as a doctor or dentist and understand your personal financial needs

feeds.title: Generational Wealth MD Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Param Baladandapani - Radiologist, full time mom, Real estate investor, and Mentor to professionals seeking Financial and Time Freedom through Real Estate Investing.

feeds.title: Dr. FIREfly Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Dr. FIREfly. I am a Canadian resident physician in my senior years of training. This is a place dedicated to those who are curious about medicine, and perhaps the financial lives of doctors.

feeds.title: Dr PayItBack
feeds.description: I'm Dr. PayItBack, a double board-certified anesthesiologist and pain management physician working in the Mid-Atlantic. I started this blog intending to serve as a real-time case study of what disciplined saving, investing, and debt payment can do for a young physician just starting out.

feeds.title: Lean Private Practice Solutions
feeds.description: My name is Mitra Sadhu. I am a practicing physician in Florida interested in spreading awareness of personal finance basics to my peers.

feeds.title: Dr. McFrugal
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Derek. I'm an anesthesiologist who also specializes in interventional pain management. I created this blog as a passion project to document my journey toward financial freedom and living my best life. Follow my journey and enjoy the ride.

feeds.title: The Motivated M.D Blog
feeds.description: The Motivated M.D. is a personal finance blog that seeks to document our journey towards financial independence while providing helpful resources and material along the way.

feeds.title: Doctored Money Blog
feeds.description: Doctored Money provides basic financial literacy education geared towards graduating medical students and residents.
